div.head: III Atr 3.3
div.ab: Et omnis emat sibi lagam duodecim oris, dimidium landesrico, dimidium wapentako.
⁊ ælc bicge him lage mid XII óran, healf landrican, healf wæpentake.
⁊ ælc bicge him lage mid XII óran, healf landrican, healf wæpentake.
And each of them shall pay 12 ores, half to the lord of the manor and half to the wapentake, in order to obtain the benefit of the law.
And each of them shall buy for himself [the benefit of the] law with twelve ores, half to the lord of the estate, half to the wapentake.
Und [deren] jeder kaufe sich Rechtsschutz mit 12 Ör, halb dem Immunitätsherrn, halb dem Wapentake.
And let each [of them] buy himself legal protection with 12 ores, half to the lord of the immunity, half to the wapentake.
